import unreal, math, json
ss = unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem)
acts = ss.get_all_level_actors()
pads = sorted([a for a in acts if "Player_Spawner" in a.get_class().get_name()], key=lambda a: a.get_actor_label())
sx, sy, sz, yaw = -1076.1, -531.1, 106.0, 26.27
r = math.radians(yaw); nx, ny = -math.sin(r), math.cos(r)   # left-hand normal to the facing direction
out = []
for i, p in enumerate(pads):
    off = (-1.5 if i == 0 else 1.5) * 100
    loc = unreal.Vector(sx + nx * off, sy + ny * off, sz + 15)
    p.modify(); p.set_actor_location(loc, False, False); p.set_actor_rotation(unreal.Rotator(0, 0, yaw), False)
    out.append((p.get_actor_label(), [round(loc.x), round(loc.y), round(loc.z)]))
# anything solid at the new spot? (buildings / fills only)
hits = []
for a in acts:
    l = a.get_actor_label()
    if not l.startswith(("L_Bldg", "L_Fill", "L_Store", "L_Sign")): continue
    o, e = a.get_actor_bounds(False)
    if abs(sx - o.x) < e.x + 200 and abs(sy - o.y) < e.y + 200: hits.append(l)
unreal.EditorLevelLibrary.save_current_level()
json.dump({"pads": out, "near": hits}, open(r"C:\Users\211in\Downloads\CCG_UEFN\level\spawn_fix.json", "w"), indent=1)

import unreal, math, json
ss = unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem)
ALL = {a.get_actor_label(): a for a in ss.get_all_level_actors()}
out = {"moved": [], "errors": []}
def mv(lbl, x, y, z, yaw):
    a = ALL.get(lbl)
    if not a: out["errors"].append(("missing", lbl)); return
    a.modify(); a.set_actor_location(unreal.Vector(x, y, z), False, False); a.set_actor_rotation(unreal.Rotator(0, 0, yaw), False); out["moved"].append(lbl)
yaw = 26.27; r = math.radians(yaw); tx, ty = math.cos(r), math.sin(r); nx, ny = -math.sin(r), math.cos(r)
sx, sy, sz = -1076.1, -531.1, 106.0
# rider select: selector zone on each podium, its button 1.5 m toward the spawn, facing the spawn
for i in range(7):
    c = ALL.get("FD_Class_%d" % i)
    if not c: continue
    p = c.get_actor_location()
    mv("FD_ClassSel_%d" % i, p.x, p.y, p.z, yaw)
    mv("FD_Btn_Rider_%d" % i, p.x + nx * 150, p.y + ny * 150, p.z, yaw + 90)
# debug trick buttons: a row 3 m behind the spawn (away from the podiums), 1.5 m apart
for i in range(6):
    d = (i - 2.5) * 150
    mv("FD_Btn_Debug_%d" % i, sx + tx * d - nx * 300, sy + ty * d - ny * 300, sz, yaw - 90)
# sunset + effects: a kiosk 4.5 m behind the spawn
mv("FD_Btn_Sunset", sx - tx * 120 - nx * 450, sy - ty * 120 - ny * 450, sz, yaw - 90)
mv("FD_Btn_Effects", sx + tx * 120 - nx * 450, sy + ty * 120 - ny * 450, sz, yaw - 90)
# store: 23 button/granter pairs in two rows in front of the store (metres -> cm this time)
st = ALL.get("L_Store_OceanDreamPlaza")
if st:
    sl = st.get_actor_location(); syaw = st.get_actor_rotation().yaw; rr = math.radians(syaw)
    # after the building flip the store body extends toward local +Y away from the road; the forecourt is local -Y
    for i in range(23):
        dx = (-6 + (i % 12) * 1.0) * 100; dy = -(3 + (i // 12) * 2.0) * 100
        x = sl.x + dx * math.cos(rr) - dy * math.sin(rr); y = sl.y + dx * math.sin(rr) + dy * math.cos(rr)
        mv("FD_Btn_Store_%02d" % i, x, y, sl.z, syaw + 180)
        mv("FD_Granter_Store_%02d" % i, x, y, sl.z - 150, syaw)
    # store volume centred on the forecourt rows
    v = ALL.get("FD_Vol_Store")
    if v:
        dy = -400; x = sl.x - dy * math.sin(rr); y = sl.y + dy * math.cos(rr)
        v.set_actor_location(unreal.Vector(x, y, sl.z + 150), False, False); out["moved"].append("FD_Vol_Store")
    out["store"] = [round(sl.x), round(sl.y), round(syaw, 1)]
unreal.EditorLevelLibrary.save_current_level()
json.dump(out, open(r"C:\Users\211in\Downloads\CCG_UEFN\level\relayout_out.json", "w"), indent=1)
unreal.log("CCGL relayout %d moved" % len(out["moved"]))

import unreal, math, json
ss = unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem)
ALL = {a.get_actor_label(): a for a in ss.get_all_level_actors()}
st = ALL["L_Store_OceanDreamPlaza"]; sl = st.get_actor_location(); o, e = st.get_actor_bounds(False)
syaw = st.get_actor_rotation().yaw; rr = math.radians(syaw)
# unit vector from origin toward the body centre, and its sign along local +Y
bx, by = o.x - sl.x, o.y - sl.y
ly = (-math.sin(rr)) * bx + math.cos(rr) * by    # projection on local +Y
side = -1.0 if ly > 0 else 1.0                    # forecourt is the opposite side of the body
out = {"origin": [round(sl.x), round(sl.y)], "bounds_c": [round(o.x), round(o.y)], "ext": [round(e.x), round(e.y)], "ly": round(ly), "forecourt_side": side}
for i in range(23):
    dx = (-6 + (i % 12) * 1.0) * 100; dy = side * (1.2 + (i // 12) * 1.3) * 100
    x = sl.x + dx * math.cos(rr) - dy * math.sin(rr); y = sl.y + dx * math.sin(rr) + dy * math.cos(rr)
    b = ALL.get("FD_Btn_Store_%02d" % i); g = ALL.get("FD_Granter_Store_%02d" % i)
    if b: b.set_actor_location(unreal.Vector(x, y, sl.z), False, False); b.set_actor_rotation(unreal.Rotator(0, 0, syaw + (0 if side > 0 else 180)), False)
    if g: g.set_actor_location(unreal.Vector(x, y, sl.z - 150), False, False)
v = ALL.get("FD_Vol_Store")
if v:
    dy = side * 200; v.set_actor_location(unreal.Vector(sl.x - dy * math.sin(rr), sl.y + dy * math.cos(rr), sl.z + 150), False, False)
# camera on the forecourt looking at the store face
dy = side * 1400; cx, cy = sl.x - dy * math.sin(rr), sl.y + dy * math.cos(rr)
look = math.degrees(math.atan2(sl.y - cy, sl.x - cx))
unreal.EditorLevelLibrary.set_level_viewport_camera_info(unreal.Vector(cx, cy, sl.z + 450), unreal.Rotator(0, -14, look))
unreal.EditorLevelLibrary.save_current_level()
json.dump(out, open(r"C:\Users\211in\Downloads\CCG_UEFN\level\store_fix.json", "w"), indent=1)

import unreal, json
ss = unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem)
acts = ss.get_all_level_actors()
pads = [a for a in acts if "PlayerSpawn" in a.get_class().get_name() or "Spawn Pad" in a.get_actor_label() or "SpawnPad" in a.get_actor_label()]
out = []
for p in pads:
    l = p.get_actor_location(); hits = []
    for a in acts:
        lab = a.get_actor_label()
        if not lab.startswith("L_"): continue
        o, e = a.get_actor_bounds(False)
        if abs(l.x - o.x) < e.x and abs(l.y - o.y) < e.y and o.z + e.z > l.z - 50 and o.z - e.z < l.z + 50: hits.append((lab, round(o.z + e.z)))
    out.append({"label": p.get_actor_label(), "cls": p.get_class().get_name(), "loc": [round(l.x), round(l.y), round(l.z)], "under_or_at": hits[:6]})
json.dump(out, open(r"C:\Users\211in\Downloads\CCG_UEFN\level\spawn_check.json", "w"), indent=1)

import unreal, json
ss = unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem)
sx, sy = -1076.1, -531.1
out = []
for a in ss.get_all_level_actors():
    l = a.get_actor_label()
    if l.startswith("L_"): continue
    p = a.get_actor_location()
    if abs(p.x - sx) < 900 and abs(p.y - sy) < 900:
        o, e = a.get_actor_bounds(False)
        out.append((l, a.get_class().get_name(), [round(p.x), round(p.y), round(p.z)], [round(e.x), round(e.y), round(e.z)]))
json.dump(out, open(r"C:\Users\211in\Downloads\CCG_UEFN\level\near_spawn.json", "w"), indent=1)
